paper.title_en: Reflecting Baths and Black Hole Interior Islands in JT Gravity
paper.abstract_en: We study the evolution of entanglement entropy within the island prescription in Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity coupled to finite non-gravitating baths bounded by reflecting walls. For free massless Dirac matter, we study the evolution of entanglement entropy, explicitly accounting for correlations induced by the reflecting boundaries. For sufficiently short baths, the no-island entropy saturates below the thermodynamic black hole entropy, avoiding the usual information paradox associated with its unbounded growth. For larger baths, reflected correlations drive the exterior quantum extremal surface toward the future horizon, leading to a temporary disappearance of the the near-horizon exterior island branch. We find that this branch first appears at a scrambling-like scale, and it reappears at a time that is proportional to the size of the bath. We extend the extremization across the horizon using regular Kruskal coordinates and identify real quantum extremal surfaces in the black hole interior. We show that, in the parameter regime studied, interior island configurations provide the dominant contribution to the radiation entropy during the exterior disappearance time interval, resolving the reappearance of the information paradox in an exterior-only description.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在JT引力耦合有限反射浴的设定下研究island公式中的纠缠熵演化，显式考虑反射边界诱导的关联，给出无island熵饱和、外区量子极值面移动与黑洞内部island分支主导的结论，属于黑洞熵与量子极值面方向的实质性理论研究，值得点进阅读。
decision.title_zh: JT引力中反射浴与黑洞内部岛
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究在Jackiw-Teitelboim引力中、耦合于由反射壁界定的有限非引力浴时，island处方框架内纠缠熵的演化。对于自由无质量Dirac物质，我们研究纠缠熵的演化，并显式计入反射边界所诱导的关联。对于足够短的浴，无island熵在低于热力学黑洞熵处饱和，从而避免了通常与其无界增长相关的信息悖论。对于更大的浴，反射关联将外部量子极值面推向未来视界，导致近视界外部island分支暂时消失。我们发现该分支首次出现在类似scrambling的尺度上，并在与浴的尺寸成正比的时间重新出现。我们使用正则Kruskal坐标将极值化扩展跨越视界，并在黑洞内部识别出真实的量子极值面。我们表明，在所研究的参数范围内，内部island构型在外部消失的时间区间内对辐射熵提供主导贡献，从而解决了仅用外部描述时信息悖论的重新出现问题。
